inlineSql: SELECT FINE_GL_RATE,FINE_SL_RATE,VCH_DATE,GR_RATE,GR_TYPE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE IN ('FGL','FSL') ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.VCH_TYPE,A.VCH_NO,FORMAT(A.VCH_DATE,'dd/MM/yyyy') As CurDate,D.AC_NAME,A.TAG_NO,C.IT_NAME,A.ITM_PCS,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_NWT,A.ITM_FINE,B.KR_NET_WT,B.KR_FINE, A.ITM_AMT,A.LBR_AMT,A.OTH_AMT,B.KR_LBR_AMT,B.KR_OTH_AMT,A.ITM_MRP,B.KR_COST,C.IT_TYPE,A.CO_BOOK,A.BOOK_NAME,A.VCH_SRNO,A.IT_CODE FROM ((MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_SIGN = '-' AND A.TR_TYPE = 'S' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT B.GR_TOUCH FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '

SELECT FINE_GL_RATE,FINE_SL_RATE,VCH_DATE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND GR_CODE IN ('FGL','FSL') ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.VCH_TYPE,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.BOOK_NAME,A.ITM_PCS,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_NWT,A.ITM_AMT,A.LBR_AMT,A.OTH_AMT,A.ITM_MRP,B.AC_NAME,A.NET_AMT,A.ITM_FINE, CASE WHEN A.TAG_NO = 'N' THEN A.KR_FINE ELSE D.KR_FINE END AS KR_FINE,D.KR_LBR_AMT,CASE WHEN A.TAG_NO = 'N' THEN A.KR_OTH_AMT ELSE D.KR_OTH_AMT END AS KR_OTH_AMT,CASE WHEN A.TAG_NO = 'N' THEN A.KR_COST ELSE D.KR_COST END AS KR_COST,C.IT_TYPE,C.IT_NAME,A.TAG_NO,A.IT_CODE,C.RATE_TYPE,C.AVG_RATE,A.IT_CODE FROM ((MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = D.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = D.VCH_SRNO) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_SIGN = '-' AND A.TR_TYPE = 'S' AND A.BOOK_NAME IN ('SALES','WH SALES','TOUR SALES','LABOUR WORK') ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

SELECT B.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,B.MAIN_BOOK FROM (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT B.GR_TOUCH,A.IT_TYPE FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
SELECT SUM(NET_AMT) As SlAmt,SUM(PR_COST) As PrAmt FROM SL_PR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' HAVING SUM(PR_COST) > 0

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ?
